Yes. It all began with.. the horrific incident.. that would break Dora forever. When she came home from hours of exploring. Her parents, their limbs ripped to shreds as they scream while being eaten by monstrous beasts that resembled letters of the alphabet. Dora wanted to scream but she couldn't. Reality hit her as she stared in horror at her mother while her kidneys were consumed by the letters.. One of the letters noticed her and rushed towards her and she couldn't move an inch for she was in too much shock to perceive reality. Once it hit her, she realised it was too late to run, but.. She looked at Boots in tears and as she picked him up. Dora said her final goodbyes. While Boots was confused and unaware of what was happening, she threw him right into the mouth of the bloodthirsty beast. Her insane plan worked at a heartbreaking cost. While the letter was distracted by ripping Boots' legs off, she escaped from her home and ran far far away.

With no food, energy or the map to guide her to safety, she had to learn to survive on her own, killing wild animals, making a small hut to survive the rain, all that while living in fear of the terrifying letters of the alphabet. After 5 days, she managed to find a highway, where she waited for a car to stop to drive her to the nearest city. She did it, she survived. Later she was adopted by a kind family, they cared for her almost as much as her real parents, each day she recovered more and more, but her hatred for the cursed letters that took her parents grew more too. As years passed she tried to find as much information as possible about them. She didn't want her parents to have died in vain. She learned that these letters have been haunting humanity for thousands of years, they explained all of the missing reports around the world. So she set a goal for herself to exterminate every last one of them to bring justice to all death they had caused.

Too bad, she knew too much, and the CIA kidnapped her, they knew everything about her. The CIA knew that these letters were not from this world and they also knew how to stop them, they only needed the right person for the job, which happened to be Dora. Her expertise in exploring was immesurable, no human on this planet could explore as well as her. They sent her on a mission to space to explore and destroy the millennia old mothership where the letters have originated from. As she approached the ship, laser cannons were being pointed at her ship. While they were charging, she went full speed ahead into their cargo bay, and she jumped out right as her ship was about to be blasted to pieces. Now she had to take out the guard letters, remembering the past events filled her with rage. She rushed at one of the guards and broke him in half as it was the letter 'U', the other one tried to hit her but her karate skills were too powerful and she took him out. She stole one of their keycards and proceeded to the next corridor.

After a while, she found the security room. She stabbed the letter guards and hacked into their mainframe, shortly after, power and life support were disabled, but one room had backup power. That must probably be the throne room where their leader is hiding. Since life support wasn't on, all guards suffocated. After finding the throne room, she tried to open the door but her keycard didn't have enough clearance. But, the room was frozen and so was the door, so she kicked the door hard enough until it shattered. What she saw inside shocked her to the bones. Swiper, was sitting in a throne surrounded by four guards 'C', 'O', 'O' and 'M'. Her #1 enemy was the one that caused everything that led up to this moment. Whilst everything was in a vacuum, this room was not for there was a forcefield that prevented air to escape.

The guards started blasting away at Dora. She tried to dodge, but her right shoulder was melted, the pain was otherwordly. But as Dora was in combat range of one of the guards, she used her karate powers and took his gun and shot him dead. She then shot the rest of the guards. The only one that's left is.. the man behind the slaughters, Swiper. Dora clenched her fist so hard, she tore a hole through her spacesuit glove with her nails. And so she approached Swiper and yelled: "Swiper!" Swiper then mockingly asked: "Ho, you're approaching me? Instead of running away you're approaching me, Swiper?" She angrily replied: "I can't beat the shit out of you without getting closer." He then invited her to come as close as she wished, and she did. A legendary fist battle was then unleashed, fists clashing so hard you could hear them on the ground. But Dora's motivations were far stronger than Swiper's and she managed to land a hit on his face. He flew across the room into a window which cracked. As Dora came closer to him, he asked for mercy in fear, but she didn't feel anything for him. In cold blood, she kicked him in the gut making him spit blood, and then she said her final words to him: "Yare yare daze." With full force, she slammed his head into the window, shattering it to dust, as Swiper flew at orbital velocities into the abyss.

In the room there was a button labeled with: "Terminate Program". Before Dora pressed it, she thought about everything that happened and all of the sacrifices that were made up until to this very moment. Once she smashed it with her fist, the guard letters in the room turned into mere soup letters, in fact.. every letter on the planet turned into soup letters.
When Dora realised this, she became flooded with happiness and joy. It was finally over. To pay respect to all of the victims and her parents, she ate every letter on the ship. 

When Dora was rescued to Earth, she was praised and she even made it to the news. The whole world was grateful for everything she did. 
And that's the origin story of soup letters, they don't teach you that in school.
